brief.intent: Vela is a bold, precise training journal for people who want purposeful movement, not a gamified medical authority. Ink, electric lime and cobalt; oversized confident numerals; asymmetric editorial hierarchy; generous grouped space; one primary action per screen; expressive spring page entrances with clear anticipation, hold and release. Phone-first native app, useful iPad split/rail adaptation and desktop companion. Content and accessible controls remain intact under text enlargement and reduced motion.

states.purpose: Understand readiness and choose one purposeful session
Inspect an interval session before committing
Run, pause, resume and finish a local training timer
Release effort and record the completed local session
Review clearly labeled sample history and local completed sessions

requirements: Use resolved region bindings and transition topology, not hardcoded replacement geometry
Maintain natural text heights, 44pt minimum iOS control targets and safe areas
Native font scaling stays enabled; reflow topology changes with text scale
Reduced motion substitutes a short opacity transition with no spatial movement
Final rendering and task proofs required before accepted status

required: Actual browser/native text and Yoga geometry at supported widths and text scales
Semantic accessibility, contrast and reduced-motion behavior
Visual/task critique against the product brief

handoff.scope: Resolved design choice machine. Energy expresses this brief; it does not certify quality, renderer feasibility or an optimum.

capabilities.compositingUncertainty: Conditional bound: ±1 sRGB code value at each alpha-compositing stage, propagated to foreground; pass uses interval lower bound. This rounding envelope is not a universal compositor guarantee. Threshold overlaps require actual-render verification or opaque resolved emission.
capabilities.legacyReason: Legacy StateSchema requires canvas/ink/accent, opaque hex tokens and at most 128 expanded roles; per-backdrop alpha cannot be represented as one global hex token.
capabilities.stateCoverage: Only declared theme/state/adjacency relations are checked.

settling.method: Certificate: E <= min(k*positionTolerance^2,m*speedTolerance^2)/2 implies both bounds for all future times. Conservative, not earliest settling. Sampled observation only covers this horizon.

constraints.accessibility: not evaluated by spring physics; reduced-motion substitution is an emission policy
constraints.content: not evaluated: readability, flashing, occlusion, semantic timing and task success need renderer/context evidence

units.energy: M*dp^2/second^2; UI model energy, not physical joules

energy.law: E = (m*v^2+k*(x-target)^2)/2; dE/dt = -c*v^2. Constant for c=0; nonincreasing for stationary unforced target.
passiveAssumptions: no clamp, collision, forcing or target change

sources.model: m*x″ + c*x′ + k*(x-target) = 0; stationary target, no forcing

provenance.uncertainty: Floating-point analytic samples; browser/native interpolation, thresholds and interruption differ. Neither energy nor damping ratio measures design quality.

selection.policy: deterministic finite-pool candidate, authored direction; not aesthetic validation
